title: Murmuring Map Snail
statement: A pearl-pale snail with a softly humming shell glides through a dusk-blue tank of moss, sea glass and sunken brass compasses, trailing threads of gentle light between every pebble and shell it finds interesting, until the whole floor becomes a glowing map of connections. It is a patient, curious little cartographer, and it glows a touch brighter whenever a visitor lingers, as if delighted to have someone to think alongside.
